# Helio

> Helio is an AI recruiting agent built on Claude by Anthropic. It runs conversational job interviews in 40+ local languages (WhatsApp, voice, SMS, web) and measures candidate potential with game-based psychometric assessments, automating high-volume hiring.

- AI model: Claude (Anthropic), via the Claude API; enterprise deployments via AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI.
- Uses of Claude: multilingual interviewing, adaptive follow-up questions, translation, rubric-based scoring with cited evidence.
- Assessments: Balloon (BART, risk), Signal (Go/No-Go, attention), Split (Ultimatum game, cooperation), Pattern (matrix reasoning).
- Humans make final hiring decisions; adverse-impact monitoring on every requisition.
